name: ds4
description: Runs DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.x, and Qwen models locally on Metal, CUDA, or ROCm with a native engine, a CLI, a coding agent, and an OpenAI-compatible server.

skills.name: Local API Server
skills.description: Serves OpenAI-style chat, Responses, completions, and Anthropic-style messages endpoints with tools and SSE streaming.

skills.name: Native Coding Agent
skills.description: Runs ds4-agent directly on the model without an HTTP server, using the model's native tool format and saved sessions.

skills.name: SSD Streaming
skills.description: Streams model weights from SSD so smaller Macs can run large models, such as full GLM 5.x on 128 GB systems.

skills.name: Multi-GPU Serving
skills.description: Uses multiple CUDA cards, including Ada Lovelace L40S, as a multi-user LLM server for the supported models.
